title: trace skill output schema
description: Schema for a saved trace artifact (.context/traces/*.md). Defines front-matter fields and structural rules. The structural rules below are enforced by scripts/validate-trace.py; JSON Schema covers only the front-matter shape.

context_commit_alignment.description: Per-repo: the commit recorded in .context/$REPO/context.md AND the actual repo HEAD at trace time. If they differ, staleness was detected.

prior_trace_consulted.description: Path to a prior trace if this trace built on one

depends_on.description: Paths of prior traces this one extends or refines

structuralRules._note: Not enforced by JSON Schema; enforced by scripts/validate-trace.py.
rules: Every trace MUST have YAML front-matter delimited by '---' on the first line.
Every trace MUST begin (after front-matter) with the preamble line: '**Trace:** <input> · <type> · via <files>'.

Every section heading MUST be followed by a '<!-- confidence: HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW -->' annotation on the next non-blank line, EXCEPT the H1 title and H3+ subsections (which inherit their parent H2 section's confidence).
Every HIGH-confidence section MUST contain at least one `path:LINE` or `path:LINE-LINE` citation.
Every cited `path:LINE` MUST resolve in the repo at the recorded `head_commit`.
An overall confidence summary MUST appear at the end: 'Overall: <CONF> (<N> HIGH, <M> MEDIUM, <K> LOW)'.
question: How [X] Works, Entry Point, Flow, (optional: Key Data Shapes, Non-Obvious Behavior, Where to Look Next)
bug: Diagnosis, Root Cause, Fix Design, Side Effects & Risks, Verification
feature: Design Summary, Insertion Points, Interface Contracts, (optional: Schema Changes), Implementation Sequence, Risks & Open Questions
refactor: Current State, Target State, Migration Plan, (optional: Interface Changes), Risk Assessment
If the trace was produced under staleness warnings, a 'Staleness Notes' section MUST appear before 'Overall' summary.
